title: DROP TABLE & CASCADE Behavior
description: Safely remove tables, manage foreign key cascades with CASCADE vs RESTRICT, and verify IF EXISTS.

data.text: The **`DROP TABLE`** statement permanently removes a table, its data, associated indexes, and triggers from the database.

data.title: DROP TABLE with CASCADE
data.content: Dropping a table and all dependent views or foreign keys automatically.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Always include `IF EXISTS` to avoid script errors when the table is absent.
`CASCADE` drops dependent views and foreign keys automatically.
`RESTRICT` (default) prevents dropping if dependent objects exist.
